Some cited-claim descriptions also do not fit the data.","problems":["Headline says 'in every complexity tier' and 'shows signs of templated or cloned notes' as established, while the leaning is 'inconclusive' and the body says 'not proof'; the headline overstates and is inconsistent.","Unmatched numbers 14 and 38 (data 14%, late 38%) are not on the card; the note-check figures (problems 29%, late 38%) and 'no audit trail received' are not verifiable from the packet, and the card shows no such note-check data.","Claims a 'high duplicate-note rate' and 'repeated visit times' with no supporting numbers in the card or summary figures; these are unsupported.","Describes 99215s for 'upper respiratory infection, rash and follow-up visits' citing C0068194, C0068180, C0068296, C0068406; the card dx are J06.9, R21, Z09, Z09, so 'rash' (R21) and 'follow-up' (Z09 as exam) are loosely mapped, and C0068406/C0068296 are Z09 exams rather than a clear match.","'Roughly ten times the all-provider rate even among patients with no chronic conditions' is 0.178/0.018 ≈ 9.9, which is acceptable, but 'ten times' is stated loosely and the same ratio is not given in the numbers.","Cited claims are only two (C0068075, C0068088), the first two rows of the low-complexity list, rather than the best examples; C0068088 with heart failure is a weak illustration of low complexity.","Next steps are generic: they do not name the EHR audit trail request or note-text comparison for specific claims, even though the rationale recommends them."]}
